summary: The candidate is a partial functional fix: its rebuilt native constructor guard prevents the reported 4/4 invalid free, but its claimed early server-argument validation uses assert and disappears under python -O. Full NVIDIA/Qwen HTTP serving was unavailable on the prepared AMD ROCm host.

tests.command: PYTHONPATH=/job/repo/python SGLANG_JIT_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-b5a9caeaccab/review-cache-base-1 timeout 300 /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-b5a9caeaccab/venv/bin/python -u -c '<production NgramCorpus capacity=4, depth=4, one four-token insertion>'
tests.what_was_measured: Recorded-base failure reproduced after a fresh native JIT build: construction and queueing succeeded, then Trie insertion aborted with munmap_chunk(): invalid pointer.
Fresh candidate native build rejected 4/4 and 3/4 synchronously and successfully inserted at 5/4 and 3/2.
45 native-backed NGRAM corpus tests passed against the candidate-built shared library.
All 4 candidate validation unit tests passed in normal Python mode.

tests.command: PYTHONPATH=/job/repo/python /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-b5a9caeaccab/venv/bin/python -O -c '<construct resolved NGRAM ServerArgs at 4/4; call validate_ngram_capacity>'
tests.what_was_measured: Independent adversarial case printed OPTIMIZED_ACCEPTED, proving assert-based early validation is removed under optimized Python.

gpu_execution.evidence: The trie extension exercised here is CPU-only. The host exposed one AMD Instinct MI350X, but no GPU kernel was used for this reproduction.

remaining_counterexamples: Under python -O, validate_ngram_capacity accepts NGRAM capacity=4 and max_trie_depth=4 because its assert is stripped; the native constructor catches it later rather than the serving-argument validation layer.
remaining_limitations: The original NVIDIA L40S/CUDA/Qwen3-4B HTTP serving reproduction was not run because the prepared environment has AMD MI350X/ROCm and lacks the reported weights.
NGRAM serving declares CUDA or CPU support, so no ROCm serving claim is made.
No model semantic accuracy, HTTP transport, or distributed workload was tested.
